# Input validation
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    if np.any(np.isnan(tau_filter)) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only nonpositive values")
    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted future-token losses: -sum(weight * logp)
    def weighted_loss(logp_matrix):
        return -np.sum(logp_matrix * normalized_weights, axis=1)

    L_with_result = weighted_loss(logp_with_result)
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only)
    L_no_call = weighted_loss(logp_no_call)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # Margin and filtering
    margin = L_minus - L_with_result
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
